_readme: Weekly Trustpilot tracking data for the /trustpilot-reviews/ tracker. Scores and review counts are REAL, search-verified public figures (Trustpilot blocks scraping, so they are gathered via search and cross-checked across sources; per-snapshot 'asOf' and 'sources' record when/where). 'praise'/'complaints' are recurring sentiment THEMES from the real review corpus — never fabricated verbatim reviews with invented reviewer names. RANKING/movement is driven by TrustScore only. The first comparison uses each firm's previous published figure (baseline dates vary, see prior 'asOf'); from here, add a new object to 'weeks' each week (Monday date) via trustpilot-update.mjs so deltas become true week-over-week.

weeks.note: Baseline: each firm's previous published Trustpilot figure. Dates vary (see asOf).

praise: Fast, reliable payouts (often processed within 24 hours)
Challenge/evaluation fee refunded with the first payout
Responsive, multilingual customer support
Clear, transparent and consistently applied rules
Solid platform and analytics tools (MetriX dashboard, coaching)
complaints: Account terminations/breaches seen as unfair or triggered by edge cases
Strict rules and a demanding evaluation (low first-attempt pass rate)
Slower support response times during high-volume periods
Challenge fees / pricing viewed as expensive
Disputes over the consistency rule or broker execution affecting payouts
ftmo.take: FTMO remains the most-reviewed and one of the highest-rated prop firms on Trustpilot, holding a stable 4.8/5 across 46,000+ reviews that consistently praise reliable payouts, fee refunds and support. Negative feedback clusters on strict rule enforcement and occasional breach/consistency disputes rather than non-payment, so disciplined traders who follow the rules tend to have the smoothest experience.

praise: Fast, reliable payouts often processed within hours
Responsive and helpful live-chat customer support
Generous profit splits and a rewarding scaling structure
Flexible, achievable challenge models (no time limits, consistency options)
Stable platform with broad account and market variety (CFD & Futures)
complaints: Accounts breached near payout eligibility, sometimes citing rule violations without clear evidence
Slippage and spread widening on funded accounts during news events
Inconsistent support quality, with tickets left unanswered on complex cases
Strict enforcement of prohibited-strategy rules (EA/copy/news trading)
Withdrawal/payout fees (up to ~3.5%) and occasional payout delays beyond stated timeframes
fundednext.take: FundedNext carries one of the strongest and highest-volume Trustpilot profiles in the prop space (4.5/5 across ~74k reviews), with consistent praise for fast payouts and responsive support. The recurring risks to weigh are near-payout account breaches and strict rule enforcement, so read the trading rules carefully before scaling.

praise: Fast payouts, often processed within hours
Responsive support via an active Discord community
Intuitive, easy-to-use trader dashboard
Clear and transparent trading rules
Good-value, low-cost challenges with reliable withdrawals
complaints: News-trading restrictions on funded accounts
Account closures tied to the Risk Per Trade Idea rule, often unexplained
Confusion over how the daily-loss and 1% max-risk rules are applied
Program changes moving profitable traders to trailing drawdown with lower splits
Ambiguous equity-on-balance breach notices near payout windows
fundingpips.take: FundingPips holds a steady 4.5/5 across one of the largest review volumes in the prop space (60k+), with consistent praise for fast payouts and support. Most negativity clusters around rule-enforcement disputes and account closures, so study the risk and news-trading rules closely before funding.

praise: Transparent, verified payouts ($43M+ paid across 20k+ payouts)
Low-pressure, no-time-limit funded model built for longevity
Scaling program that grows accounts toward $4M in capital
Low-cost challenges with profit splits up to 100%
Established track record (funding traders since 2016) on MT5
complaints: Conservative starting capital and a slow path to larger accounts
Support response times on complex or payout-related cases
An extra verification/interview step reported before some payouts
Rule strictness that can catch certain trading styles
Targets that some traders find hard relative to the small starting balance
the5ers.take: The5ers holds a strong ~4.7 Trustpilot score across 30,000+ reviews, backed by a long record of transparent, verified payouts ($43M+ paid) and a low-pressure scaling model reaching up to $4M. Complaints are mostly operational — support friction and a conservative, slow-scaling evaluation — rather than payment-integrity concerns.

praise: Fast, reliable payouts (often next trading day via Wise)
Long, proven track record and legitimacy (funding traders since 2012)
Genuine funded capital with transparent, clearly written rules
Solid trader education, coaching and community resources
Recent TopstepX platform interface improvements
complaints: Intraday trailing drawdown locks accounts during winning sessions on normal pullbacks
Strict rule enforcement causing account closures traders feel are minor or unclear
Recurring Combine subscription / auto-renewal fees add up and cause billing confusion
Proprietary TopstepX platform seen as a downgrade from TradingView, plus occasional outages
Slow or unhelpful support during high-volume events (NFP, FOMC)
topstep.take: Topstep is one of the longest-running futures prop firms with a large review base and a strong payout reputation, but its middling ~3.6 TrustScore is weighed down by its tight intraday trailing-drawdown mechanic and complaints about the TopstepX platform. It suits disciplined traders comfortable with strict intraday risk rules rather than those chasing loose evaluations.

praise: Fast, automated payouts (often within 24-48 hours under the 4.0 system)
Cheap, frequently discounted evaluations
Lenient, easy-to-pass evaluation rules
Responsive and helpful customer support
Generous profit split and a wide range of account sizes
complaints: Payouts held, delayed or denied — sometimes citing rules users say were removed
Accounts closed after becoming profitable, with vague 'erratic/windfall trading' reasoning
Confusing, frequent rule changes since the March 2026 4.0 rebuild
Recurring subscription billing users forgot to cancel
Support goes quiet during disputes; strict compliance checks (ID/video) on large withdrawals
apex.take: Apex remains one of the most-reviewed futures prop firms, holding a still-strong ~4.2 TrustScore across 20,000+ reviews, with traders praising cheap, easy evaluations and fast automated payouts. The score has drifted down from 4.4 earlier in 2026 as complaints about held or denied payouts and post-4.0 rule changes persist, so read the current payout rules closely before funding.

praise: Fast, reliable payouts (often within 24-48h via Rise)
Responsive, helpful live-chat support
No daily loss limit on the plans
Smooth path from evaluation to funded accounts
Good variety of plans and platform flexibility
complaints: Repeated/extra KYC verification requests before payout
Accounts held or flagged for alleged rule violations after payout requests
The Feb 2026 profit-split cut from 90% to 80% drew backlash
Pricing higher than rivals, plus Pro-tier price increases
Consistency-rule friction on evaluations and weak support escalation
myfundedfutures.take: MyFundedFutures holds an exceptional ~4.9 Trustpilot score across roughly 20,000 reviews, powered by consistently fast payouts and responsive support. The main friction points traders raise are extra KYC checks, occasional rule-based account holds, and lingering resentment over the early-2026 profit-split reduction to 80%.

praise: Fast, reliable payouts (often same or next day)
Day-one payout eligibility on PRO accounts, no minimum trading days
Clear, well-documented rules and a straightforward evaluation
Helpful, professional support agents (named staff praised)
Established, trusted futures firm operating since 2021
complaints: PRO-phase intraday trailing drawdown catches traders off guard
Accounts banned or disabled after becoming profitable
Slow or unresponsive support during disputes and busy periods
Payout delays and accounts left 'under review' without explanation
Tradovate platform stability issues and outages
takeprofittrader.take: Take Profit Trader remains one of the most-reviewed futures prop firms, holding a roughly 4.4/5 'Excellent' TrustScore across nearly 10,000 reviews, with fast day-one payouts driving most of the praise. Weigh that against a persistent negative cluster around the PRO-phase intraday trailing drawdown and reports of accounts being restricted after they turn profitable.

praise: Fast, reliable on-demand payouts
Responsive and helpful customer support
Smooth, straightforward evaluation process
Clear rules and a transparent account dashboard
Good value: high profit split and scaling
complaints: Confusing consistency / Best-Day rule causing breaches
Disputed payout denials or account closures
KYC verification delays and failures
Platform limits for US traders (no MT5/cTrader) and MT5 glitches

e8markets.take: E8 Markets holds a solid 4.3 'Excellent' Trustpilot score across roughly 3,300 reviews, with most traders praising fast payouts and responsive support. The near-9% one-star share reflects recurring friction over funded-stage consistency rules, KYC/verification, and US platform restrictions, so read the rulebook carefully before buying.

praise: Reliable, consistent payouts (often received within one business day)
Responsive, helpful support with praised named agents
User-friendly dashboard and smooth funding/account setup
Wide platform choice (MT5, cTrader, DXTrade, TradeLocker) with competitive spreads
Fast account activation after passing evaluation stages
complaints: Occasional payout delays and slow payment-team email support
The 2-minute minimum trade duration rule causing denied payouts for scalpers
Stricter risk groups and reduced leverage imposed after passing
Account closures/bans flagged late or without clear prior warning, plus KYC inconsistencies
No challenge-fee refund on passing; limited instruments and no swap-free accounts
alphacapital.take: Alpha Capital Group holds a strong, notably stable 4.7 'Excellent' Trustpilot score across ~21,000 reviews (about 86% five-star), reflecting generally reliable payouts and responsive support. The ~7% one-star reviews cluster around the 2-minute trade rule, tighter post-funding risk limits, and late account closures, so read the rulebook closely before buying a challenge.
